notes.title: New localization, new features and weapon balance in version 1.1.5.
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]The level up and XP system will now save the player's progress continuously and not just when the game is auto saved.[/p][p]Added Russian language localization to dialogues, menus, and the store page.[/p][p]The weapon menu will now also close with the escape key.[/p][p]When exiting the vehicle, the weapon will be automatically drawn.[/p][p]The Negev machine gun base damage was increased for a better balance between weapons.[/p][p]A new message on the save / load page to clarify how the game saves your progress.[/p][p]Fixed the quick use weapon buttons so they will not allow double slots for the same weapon.[/p][p]The way point marker system was improved and it's bug fixed.[/p][p]Character lip sync is improved.[/p][p]Lock picking mini game has been fixed and works more correctly.[/p][p]Added a user icon for computers that have content.[/p][p]I fixed some bugs, unclear instructions, text misspelling and an inventory image.[/p]

notes.title: Update patch 1.01
notes.notes: [p]I fixed some bugs, unclear instructions and an inventory image.[/p][p]The level and XP system will now save the player's progress continuously and not just when the game is auto saved.[/p][p]The weapon menu will now also close with the escape key.[/p][p]When exiting the vehicle, the weapon will be automatically drawn.[/p]

notes.title: Demo patch
notes.notes:
Car trunk closing bug is fixed (the player will not get locked on close the trunk).
Player explosives now can hurt the player if he is too close.
Invert Y is now a settings feature.
Better lip sync accuracy.
Some other bugs fixed.
